photo.notes: Off-topic oak door replaced by a flat-roof pink stucco house with ribbon windows, graded cool to match the grey hero slider and blue rain (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-first.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg): one set now. copy.notes: One count (five numbers) in hero lead, hero sticker and #label h2 (1440-first.jpg, 1440-full.jpg). Deductions: #services is 8 near-identical stacked cards, ~2,400px of thumb scroll with one CTA type (390-full.jpg ~y3900-6300); the price-tag punch holes sit as stray black dots beside 'per opening' on every tag (390-full.jpg #prices ~y9800).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg shows every label meaning highlighted and every section present; static/render clean, forced-colors and print media in dist. Not 9: small light-grey text on paper stays borderline (the 'Impact glass, cut through' caption and the 'We don’t quote insurance savings' note, 1440-full.jpg #label, #compare), and the ~12px WHAT MOVES IT notes on yellow (1440-full.jpg #prices).

motion.notes: The signature now reads as a state change: #label rows closed with corner tabs in 1440-full.jpg, opened with highlighted meanings in 1440-rm-full.jpg; 390-full.jpg shows the first row peeled. Plus sliders driving #compare and month tabs driving the order-by bar (1440-full.jpg). Not 9.5: the peel is one row at a time on tap with nothing linking it to scroll, so a skimmer at 1440 sees five closed rows and white space.

wow.notes: Three tools in the thesis' language that now land: the peeling label (1440-full.jpg vs 1440-rm-full.jpg), shutters vs glass with a live '12 openings x $1,300-$2,800' (1440-full.jpg #compare), the ORDER BY Early March sticker on the hatched season (1440-full.jpg #orderby). Not 9.5: no keepable output (the homeowner can’t take 'my label, read' away).

Deductions: empty grey 'Impact glass' photo box at 1440 (1440-full.jpg #compare); stray punch-hole dots at 390 (390-full.jpg #prices); services caption truncated with an ellipsis 'tall ribbon wind…' (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

elevate.move: Turn every photo into a labelled opening: crop the services image and the compare frame to the opening itself (a slider track, a window corner with frame and sill, a French door to the pool), each carrying a small 5-number sample sticker in the corner, so the photography becomes 'products with their label' and the empty compare frame is replaced by a real impact pane in the same cool grade.

Re-cut the services stack for the thumb as a label roll: one horizontal snap row of compact sticker tabs (name + one key number + Price it), with the hero lead and actions pulled above the sticker so the 390 first screen reads headline, actions, then label, and the price tags lose the punch-hole on phones in favour of a corner curl.
